Canonicalize Spatial Source and Sink Geometries

Source: R/canonicalize.R
canonicalize_spatial.Rd

Validates schema requirements (required id column, non-empty geometries, unique identifiers) and harmonizes coordinate reference systems (CRS) by transforming source to match sink's CRS if they differ.

Usage

canonicalize_spatial(source, sink)

Arguments

source

An sf object representing source geometries (e.g. school points).

sink

An sf object representing target/sink geometries (e.g. CBG polygons).

Value

A list of class imumap_spatial containing validated source and sink sf objects with matching CRS.

Examples

pts <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(0, 0)), sf::st_point(c(1, 1)), crs = 4326)
src <- sf::st_sf(id = c("s1", "s2"), geometry = pts)
poly_mat <- matrix(c(0, 0, 2, 0, 2, 2, 0, 2, 0, 0), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
snk <- sf::st_sf(id = "c1", geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(poly_mat)), crs = 4326))
res <- canonicalize_spatial(src, snk)
